method: OOD support + training-range extrapolation guard + split-conformal interval

gate.GREEN: domain support IN_DISTRIBUTION, province support IN_DISTRIBUTION, and prediction inside the training target range
gate.YELLOW: domain WEAK_SUPPORT or prediction outside the training target range

conformal.calibration_set: out-of-fold predictions from 5-fold GroupKFold by 500 m proximity
conformal.note: Marginal interval over the national modeling population; not per-site.

note: The gate never uses observed target errors of the new sample. It is a support triage rule, not a calibrated probability. The conformal interval is marginal (global), not per-site.
